title: Real Estate Development Financial Model
description: A multi-sheet real estate development pro forma: a returns summary across scenarios, development and financing assumptions per product type, and annual cash flow projections per product type and scenario.

model_name.description: Name of the financial model as printed in the title of the returns summary sheet.

returns_summary.description: One entry per scenario column in the Returns Summary sheet.

description.description: Scenario description, e.g. the development and exit strategy.

total_square_footage.description: Total square footage of the development program.

total_development_costs_with_land.description: Total development costs including land, in dollars.

land_acquisition_cost.description: Land acquisition cost component of the equity required, in dollars.

horizontal_infrastructure_cost.description: Horizontal infrastructure cost component of the equity required, in dollars.

equity_for_vertical_buildout.description: Equity for vertical buildout, in dollars.

total_distributions.description: Total distributions to the owner over the scenario, in dollars.

net_cash_flow.description: Net cash flow after subtracting equity invested, in dollars.

npv_discount_rate.description: Discount rate used for the NPV as printed, e.g. '8%'.

irr.description: Internal rate of return as printed, e.g. '16.9%'.

product_assumptions.description: One entry per product-type Assumptions sheet (office, retail, residential, hotel).

product_type.description: Product type of the sheet: Office, Retail, Residential or Hotel.

gross_square_feet.description: Gross square feet (GSF) of the program.

construction_loan_debt_percent.description: Construction loan share of the capital stack (Debt) for the own/operate structure, as printed.

construction_loan_interest_rate.description: Construction loan interest rate as printed.

permanent_loan_interest_rate.description: Permanent loan interest rate as printed.

permanent_loan_ltv.description: Permanent loan loan-to-value ratio as printed.

permanent_loan_amortization_years.description: Permanent loan amortization period in years.

net_rent_per_sf.description: Net rent per square foot for the primary use, in dollars. Null for hotel.

vacancy_rate.description: Vacancy rate for the primary use, as printed.

total_development_costs_excluding_land.description: Total development costs excluding land, in dollars.

total_development_costs_including_land.description: Total development costs including land, in dollars.

cash_flow_scenarios.description: One entry per product-type cash flow sheet. A product type can have more than one sheet (different hold periods or a sale scenario).

product_type.description: Product type of the sheet: Office, Retail, Residential or Hotel.

scenario_name.description: Scenario heading exactly as printed under the sheet title, including ownership and leverage.

page_label.description: Page label printed in the footer of this cash flow sheet itself (bottom right), e.g. 'Page 6 of 16'. Not the label of the preceding Assumptions sheet.

total_costs.description: Total Costs, Total column, in dollars.

permanent_loan_beginning_balance.description: Permanent loan beginning balance in the first year the loan is outstanding, in dollars. Printed in parentheses as a negative; return the negative number. Null if the sheet has no permanent loan balance (e.g. a sale scenario).

first_year_dscr.description: Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) in the first year it is shown. Null if the sheet shows no DSCR row.

residual_value.description: Residual value of the primary use (e.g. 'Residual Value - Office'), Total column, in dollars.

net_cash_flow_before_debt_service.description: Net Cash Flow Before Debt Service, Total column, in dollars.

aloha_irr.description: Owner (Aloha) IRR as printed. Null if not shown.

total_aloha_distributions.description: Total Aloha Distributions, in dollars. Null if not shown.
